description: surface.list asked to filter by the narrow door on a daemon that never wired Table.NarrowMethods. The answer is the refusal that says WHY, and not an empty list: the projection's membership is a fact internal/narrow owns, this package may not import it (narrow imports protocol, never the reverse), and a daemon that never supplied the seam has not earned the right to say a method is absent from a projection it cannot see. Every entry of an unfiltered listing on such a daemon therefore reports narrow:"unknown" — a third value, never collapsed into "none".
